data.name: Mu'aawin
data.gender_notes: Mu'aawin is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who assists, a helper, supporter, or an assistant to someone or something. The name Mu'aawin carries the meaning “Assistant, Helper” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic. Parents who choose Mu'aawin usually hope their child will grow to embody assistant, helper and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that signifies one's commitment to help others and make a positive impact in their lives
data.etymology: Mu'aawin belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Assistant, Helper.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mu'aawin total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: معاون
in_arabic.meaning: مساعد، مددگار، کسی کا ساتھ دینے والا
in_arabic.long_meaning: معاون کا مطلب ہے جو کسی کا ساتھ دیتا ہے، مددگار یا معاون۔ یہ نام عربی جڑوں سے نکلا ہے، جہاں 'عین-و-ن' جڑ کا مطلب ہے 'مدد کرنا' یا 'ساتھ دینا'۔ اسلامی تقلید میں، یہ نام ان خوبیوں کی عکاسی کرتا ہے جو ایک فرد میں ہونی چاہئیں، جیسے وفاداری، تعاون اور ہمدردی۔ قرآن میں، معاون کی اصطلاح انبیاء اور اولیاء کے حوالے سے استعمال ہوتی ہے جو ایک دوسرے کی مدد کرتے ہیں۔

in_urdu.name: معاون
in_urdu.meaning: مساعد، مددگار، کسی کا ساتھ دینے والا
in_urdu.long_meaning: معاون نام عربی زبان سے لیا گیا ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے مددگار یا کسی کا ساتھ دینے والا۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقلید میں بہت اہمیت رکھتا ہے، کیونکہ یہ ان خوبियों کی نمائندگی کرتا ہے جو ایک مسلمان میں ہونی چاہئیں، جیسے وفاداری، تعاون اور ہمدردی۔ جنوبی ایشیائی اسلامی ثقافت میں، یہ نام اکثر ان افراد کو دیا جاتا ہے جو اپنے خاندان اور دوستوں کی مدد کرنے میں ہمیشہ تیار رہتے ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: मुआविन
in_hindi.meaning: मदद करने वाला, सहायक, किसी का साथ देने वाला
in_hindi.long_meaning: मुआविन नाम का अर्थ है मदद करने वाला या सहायक। यह नाम अरबी जड़ों से निकला है, जहां 'मुअविन' का अर्थ है 'मदद करना' या 'साथ देना'। भारतीय मुस्लिम समुदाय में, यह नाम उन व्यक्तियों को दिया जाता है जो अपने परिवार और दोस्तों की मदद करने में हमेशा तैयार रहते हैं। यह नाम वफादारी, सहयोग और सहानुभूति जैसे गुणों की याद दिलाता है।

in_pashto.name: معاون
in_pashto.meaning: مدد کوونکی، ملاتړ کوونکی، د چا سره یو ځای کوونکی
in_pashto.long_meaning: معاون نوم د عربي ژبې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، چې د معنی یې د مرستې کوونکی یا ملاتړ کوونکی دی. په افغان او پښتون دود کې، دا نوم هغو کسانو ته ورکول کیږي چې تل د خپلو کورنیو او دوستانو سره د مرستې لپاره چمتو وي. دا نوم د وفادارۍ، همکارۍ او همدردۍ په څیر د ځانګړتیاوو څرګندونه کوي.

in_english.name: Mu'aawin
in_english.meaning: helper, supporter, one who gives assistance
in_english.long_meaning: Mu'aawin is an Arabic name that means 'helper' or 'supporter'. It originates from the root 'ع-و-ن' which means 'to help' or 'to assist'. In Islamic tradition, this name reflects the qualities of loyalty, cooperation, and empathy. The term 'Mu'aawin' is used in the Quran to refer to prophets and companions who supported each other. This name is popular across Muslim cultures, symbolizing the importance of mutual aid and support.

data.cultural_impact: The name Mu'aawin holds a significant cultural impact in the Islamic community as it symbolizes the virtue of helping and supporting one another. It is a reminder of the importance of community and unity, emphasizing the belief that every individual has a role to play in creating a harmonious society. In practical terms, this name can remind us to extend a helping hand to those in need, showing compassion and kindness to our fellow human beings.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Mu'aawin carries the reminder of the concept of "Tawakkul" or trust in Allah. By being Mu'aawin or a supporter, we are acting as Allah's hands on Earth, helping others in need, and enhancing the divine plan. Moreover, it is a call to be a helper for ourselves, striving to develop our character, and grow spiritually, thereby becoming better servants of Allah. In this sense, the name Mu'aawin leads us towards self-improvement and a deeper connection with the divine.
data.spiritual_symbolism: The meaning "Assistant, Helper" symbolizes One who assists, a helper, supporter, or an assistant to someone or something. In Islamic spirituality, bearing the name Mu'aawin serves as a constant reminder of one's spiritual aspirations and connection to Islamic values of assistant, helper.
